name: ERTH 5735
title: Introduction to Groundwater Hydrology
description: Physics of groundwater systems, the hydrologic cycle, and groundwater's role in water supply and contamination. Specific topics include: challenges of groundwater under climate change; physical properties affecting groundwater flow; math-based understanding of groundwater processes; introduction to groundwater contaminant transport and unsaturated flow.
requirement_description: Not open for credit to students who have passed ERTH 4735 or NRE 4135.
